template_note: Project-local incident and exception log template. Use the HIPAA-aware metadata-only variant when the application handles PHI.

monitoring_phases.cadence: before unattended continuous run or release
monitoring_phases.reminder: Run dependency, secret, static analysis, and access-control checks.
monitoring_phases.evidence: scan report path and reviewed access-control notes
monitoring_phases.user_action: Confirm baseline security posture before PHI-capable development proceeds.

monitoring_phases.reminder: Monitor logs, audit events, and unexpected file or network activity for abnormal behavior.
monitoring_phases.user_action: Review possible information, credential, plan, or PHI leakage indicators.

monitoring_phases.reminder: Run dependency, secret, static analysis, and access-review checks.
monitoring_phases.user_action: Review abnormal behavior and possible information leakage.

monitoring_phases.cadence: when an incident or suspicious event is recorded
monitoring_phases.reminder: Preserve metadata-only evidence and escalate user-supervised response.
monitoring_phases.evidence: incident ID, timestamps, hashes, and evidence pointers
monitoring_phases.user_action: Decide containment, notification, credential rotation, and follow-up review steps.

incidents.summary: Template example: abnormal behavior needs review without storing sensitive values.
incidents.next_action: Review the evidence pointer, decide whether containment or escalation is needed, and continue independent slices when safe.
